meta.name: add-deltachat
meta.description: Add DeltaChat channel integration via @deltachat/stdio-rpc-server. Native adapter — no Chat SDK bridge. Email-based messaging with end-to-end encryption.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 通过 DeltaChat 集成加密邮件通信
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在应用中添加端到端加密的邮件聊天功能
copy.tagline_en: Integrate encrypted email messaging via DeltaChat
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to add end-to-end encrypted email chat to your app

howto.what: 安装后，Claude可通过DeltaChat接收和发送电子邮件消息，并使用端到端加密。它支持文件附件、群组聊天和头像设置。
howto.when: 当用户通过DeltaChat应用向机器人发送私信或群组消息时触发。也支持通过/set-avatar命令设置头像。

say.note: 通过DeltaChat发送消息给机器人，机器人会回复。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can receive and send email messages via DeltaChat with end-to-end encryption. It supports file attachments, group chats, and avatar setting.
howto.when_en: Triggered when a user sends a DM or group message to the bot via DeltaChat. Also triggered by the /set-avatar command.

say_en.text: Hello, can you check the weather?
say_en.note: Sends a message to the bot via DeltaChat; the bot replies.
Send an image with this command to change the bot's avatar. Admin/owner only.
